description: Réseau cyclable départemental is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Département des Pyrénées Orientales. Data of cycling facilities developed by the Department and known on the territory of the Eastern Pyrenees. Coverage: Département des Pyrénées Orientales. The portal shows the English title as "Departmental cycling network" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Département des Pyrénées Orientales. Its keywords include veloroutes. The listing shows 1 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2023-04-25 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
